d:
This Ram Navami 2026, experience the deep emotion and devotion of Ayodhya with "Jara Der Thahro Ram," soulfully sung by Nidhi Arora. This heart-touching bhajan captures the moment of Prabhu Shri Ram’s departure, expressing the longing of every devotee: "Abhi Humne Jee Bhar Ke Dekha Nahi Hai."
Abhi hamne ji-bhar ke dekha nahin hai - Jara Der Thahro Ram | Ram Navami Special 2026 | Hindi Bhajan Song
Song Credits:
Song Name: Jara Der Thahro Ram
Singer: Nidhi Arora
Music: Arjun Khichar
Producer: Fountain Music Company
Production: Rohit Kathuria
